dependencies.name: airwindows-console9
dependencies.purpose: Airwindows Console 9 stereo reference null tests; mono AU kernels retained as reference text, not compiled

dependencies.name: clap
dependencies.purpose: CLAP plugin ABI headers + CMake project (hosting, stock plugins; CLAP_SDK_ROOT for clap-wrapper)

dependencies.name: doctest
dependencies.purpose: Unit test framework (tests only, never shipped)

dependencies.name: fast_float
dependencies.purpose: Locale-independent float/double parsing through core-base; usable by all MIT libraries and plugins
dependencies.notes: MIT option selected from the upstream MIT/Apache-2.0/BSL-1.0 alternatives; only unmodified include/ and LICENSE-MIT are vendored. Latest stable release at least two weeks old as of 2026-10-14.

dependencies.name: dr_libs
dependencies.purpose: WAV read/write, FLAC and MP3 decode

dependencies.name: pocketfft
dependencies.purpose: FFT for offline analysis and analyzer displays

dependencies.name: signalsmith-linear
dependencies.purpose: Signalsmith Linear: STFT/FFT layer the stretch is built on (the 1.4.0 release's pinned dependency). Header only; FFT backends (Accelerate/IPP/PFFFT/XSIMD/CMSIS) off
dependencies.notes: sha256 is the upstream release tarball; the vendored files are verbatim except that upstream tests/ are not vendored

dependencies.name: signalsmith-stretch
dependencies.purpose: Pitch-preserving offline time-stretch for media takes (take.playrate/preserve_pitch/pitch, engine.md §4). Header only
dependencies.notes: sha256 is the upstream release tarball; the vendored files are verbatim except that upstream cmd/, web/ and tests/ are not vendored

dependencies.name: nanovg
dependencies.version: master @ 2026-02-19 (same pin as the plugin template)
dependencies.purpose: Vector rendering for the DAW GUI (GL3); bundles stb_truetype/stb_image (public domain or MIT)

dependencies.name: nanovg_metal
dependencies.version: master @ 1e42439 (same pin as the plugin template)
dependencies.purpose: Metal renderer for plugin editors on macOS (template GUI stack); unmodified, precompiled shader bitcode headers

dependencies.name: clap-wrapper
dependencies.purpose: Builds template-derived plugins as CLAP (and VST3/AUv2 when enabled). Bundles fmt (MIT, license in libs/fmt/fmt/format.h) and the PreSonus gain-reduction header (public domain). The template's three VST3 fixes (from ~/Projects/audio-plugins/template/cmake/) are pre-applied; copies in cmake/patches/.

dependencies.name: pugl
dependencies.purpose: Plugin editor windowing (template GUI stack); not used by the DAW shell

dependencies.name: nanovg_metal
dependencies.purpose: Metal renderer for plugin editors on macOS only (fetched by the template CMake on Apple); never built on Linux

dependencies.name: nanosvg
dependencies.purpose: SVG parsing for plugin editors built on the plugin template (framework/gui/Images.h); only the parser header is vendored (src/nanosvg.h, unmodified)

dependencies.name: lua
dependencies.purpose: Embedded scripting language (ADR-0006): libs/lua-bus runs user scripts on the model thread. Upstream src/ is unmodified; only the core and the sandbox libraries are compiled (io, os, debug and package are never built).

dependencies.name: mir
dependencies.purpose: JIT compiler and interpreter behind DSP scripts (ADR-0032): plugins/suite compiles scripts to MIR and runs them as machine code or interpreted. Only the core, generator and interpreter sources are vendored (no c2mir, tests or tools); upstream files are unmodified.

dependencies.name: vst3sdk
dependencies.purpose: VST3 hosting ABI, Linux/macOS/Windows module loaders, parameter and event helpers

dependencies.name: asiosdk
dependencies.purpose: Windows DAW ASIO backend; never plugins (ADR-0033)

dependencies.name: AudioUnitSDK
dependencies.purpose: Existing stock-plugin AUv2 wrappers on macOS (clap-wrapper pin)

dependencies.name: PortAudio
dependencies.purpose: Unmodified native source/header subset: CoreAudio macOS; WASAPI/ASIO Windows; DAW-only

system_libraries.name: SDL3
system_libraries.purpose: DAW application window, input, clipboard, DnD, dialogs (system package sdl3)

system_libraries.name: libjack (pipewire-jack)
system_libraries.purpose: JACK audio/MIDI API, dlopen'ed at runtime

system_libraries.name: libX11 / libGL
system_libraries.purpose: X11 windows, plugin GUI embedding, OpenGL
